site.name: Marcin Cuber

site.headline: I build cloud platforms that stay boring under pressure.
site.description: Marcin Cuber is a Principal Cloud Engineer and Lead Cloud Native Developer specialising in AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps and secure platforms.
site.intro: Principal-level cloud engineer with 10+ years delivering secure, observable platforms across financial services, healthcare and media. I combine hands-on AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform engineering with DevSecOps, architecture, technical leadership and the operating model that helps teams deliver with confidence.
cv_profile: Principal Cloud Engineer and Lead Cloud Native Developer with 10+ years designing and operating production platforms across financial services, healthcare and media. Combines architecture ownership with hands-on delivery across AWS, EKS and Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps and CI/CD—from multi-account landing zones, identity and network boundaries to cluster lifecycle, autoscaling, workload delivery and observability. Builds multi-region platforms for regulated, latency-sensitive and high-traffic workloads, treating reliability, security and cost as architecture constraints rather than post-production controls.

Leads platform engineering and DevSecOps from technical strategy through implementation: codifying reusable infrastructure, policy-as-code, least-privilege access, software supply-chain controls, SLOs, incident learning and FinOps guardrails into paved delivery paths. Translates business and regulatory requirements into pragmatic standards, design decisions and operating models while remaining close to code and production behaviour. Extends impact through engineering mentorship, open-source Terraform and Kubernetes implementations, and technical writing that turns operational lessons into repeatable engineering practice.

career.summary: Combining hands-on engineering and technical leadership to build resilient, modern cloud-native systems for large-scale client environments.

career.role: Principal Cloud Engineer · DevOps Technical Lead
career.summary: Set platform direction and led hands-on delivery for a secure multi-region EKS trading platform using Terraform and Flux, improving latency by 30%. Standardised Control Tower provisioning, policy-as-code and FinOps, cutting account setup time by 70% and targeted RDS/Redis costs by at least 50%.

Led platform and SRE practices for energy optimisation systems, introducing structured on-call, runbooks and blameless postmortems. Standardised delivery with EKS, CircleCI, Flux, Vault and Terraform Cloud/Sentinel, while migrating Airflow v1 to managed Airflow v2.

Progressed from Senior to Lead DevOps Engineer while building regulated multi-region platforms across Ireland, North Virginia and Beijing. Delivered EKS/ECS foundations, reusable Terraform modules, GitLab CI security gates, identity integration and regional data-residency controls for clinical applications.

Rolled out production EKS platforms with Helm and Flux, standardising DNS, secrets and observability with New Relic and Datadog. Reduced compute costs by approximately 49% through autoscaling, Spot capacity and Kubecost-guided rightsizing.

Developed Node.js and Express APIs plus Docker delivery pipelines for a high-traffic digital news product. Built AWS serverless workflows with Lambda, API Gateway and DynamoDB, supported by TeamCity, Datadog and ELK telemetry.
